## Statement from @Peters | 🇨🇱 | 19 

I know this is technically a place where all the team owners are supposed to write or speak, but I still wanted to take a moment to leave a little message.

When I first joined this league, I was honestly really nervous. I still remember my first race in Canada, in F3, and how worried I was about not being good enough or living up to expectations. I didn't really know what to expect, but as the season went on, those worries slowly started to fade away.

Throughout this season, I realized that being part of this league is about so much more than just racing, getting good results, or fighting for positions on track. It's also about the people you meet, the friendships you make, and all the experiences that turn into memories you'll always look back on.

I've met some amazing people and been part of something that started as just a racing competition but turned into something much more meaningful to me.

I honestly couldn't be happier to be part of this amazing league. I'm really glad I got the chance to make it this far, and even happier knowing there's still so much more to come.

I also wanna give a special shoutout to everyone who has been by my side throughout this journey. To those who supported me, gave me advice, and shared both the good and bad moments with me. Seriously, thank you for always being there, having my back, and being such an important part of this journey. I genuinely appreciate everything you've done for me.

If there's one thing I'll take away from this season, besides the races and results, it's definitely the people I've met along the way. You guys made this experience so special, and I hope we get to share many more moments together, both on and off the track.

Thank you all for making this league such an amazing place. I'm genuinely happy to be part of this community, and I hope I get to stick around for many more seasons.

Love y'all, and see you next season

- Peters
